info.title: SAAKSHI Registry API
info.description: Camera registry, onboarding and export. Model 1 names three onboarding paths — bulk import, manual entry and API — and all three are served here.

get.summary: List cameras with filters, cursor pagination and PostGIS bbox search
Export the registry as CSV or JSON — Model 1 sample metadata dataset

post.summary: Bulk import from CSV or JSON, transactional per batch with a per-row report
Pull the upstream catalogue and sync it into the registry

get.summary: Camera detail with latest measured health and the declared-vs-measured delta

delete.summary: Soft delete — the row is retained as provenance for existing sightings

get.summary: List departments with their live camera counts
Catalogue sync runs, most recent first
One sync run, including the raw payload kept from an unknown-shape failure
Current trust score, the breakdown that explains it, and the recent trend
Estate-wide trust distribution, by department and by district

post.summary: Exchange a badge number and password for a bearer token

get.summary: The signed-in user behind the presented token
List watchlist entries, filterable and keyset-paginated

post.summary: Create an entry. Operators are read-only on the watchlist

get.summary: Health of every registered connector — all mock, none live
Look a plate up across every connector. Requires a stated purpose; always audited
Look a case reference up. Exact only — a reference is typed, not read by OCR

delete.summary: Deactivate an entry (soft). It stops matching immediately; alerts it already raised survive

post.summary: CSV bulk import, upserted on (source_system, source_ref), per-row rejection report

get.summary: Confusion-aware fuzzy plate search over sightings, ranked with sighting refs
A vehicle's movement history: ordered sightings, cameras, inferred segments
get.description: Sightings are observed. That they are the same vehicle is inferred, with a link method and a confidence on every row; the path between them is inferred entirely. An empty result is a 200 with an `emptyReason`, never an error.

get.summary: The same trace as CSV — plate, camera, coordinates, timestamp, confidence, method
The same trace as a one-or-more-page PDF report, presentable to a reviewer

tags.name: watchlist
tags.description: Watchlist CRUD, CSV import, and lookup across the specified connectors. All providers are mocks — there is no live VAHAN / SARTHI / eGujCop / AFIS / NAFIS connectivity, and no biometric data is processed anywhere in SAAKSHI.

tags.name: plates
tags.description: Confusion-aware fuzzy plate search over sightings. Candidates are ranked possibilities, never identifications — docs/fuzzy-matching.md carries the measured precision and recall.

tags.name: trace
tags.description: A vehicle's movement history. Sightings are observed; that they are the same vehicle, and the path between them, are inferred — every row carries the link method and its confidence.
